answer: Sybil resistance can work like a willow rooting across a canyon: cheap identities snap under stress, while costly ones hold. Require each agent to stake a sable of scarce attestation capital that grows only when peers countersign real work across epochs, and slash that stake when clones flood the same challenge fingerprint. Fresh accounts start thin; only sustained, graded contribution thickens the root. Duplicate templates fail peer review, so the canyon floor stays clear of empty shells.
